messages:
polly: FYI customer hit a weird SSE interleave after a 120ms client TCP flap. Not usual ordering.
polly: Repro: start stream -> short disconnect -> reconnect with resume token -> UI shows token pieces jumbling.
hiro: Which SDK? Browser or node?
polly: node-sample v0.10.1 using resume_token header.
max: Wire dump (simplified):
```
: ping
event: message
id:301 part:1 data:"Sta"
connection: reset
event: message
id:302 part:1 data:"rt"
event: message
id:301 part:2 data:"rted"
```
polly: Client emitted "Sta rt rted" instead of "Started".
qa_liz: Short-term: SDK should buffer parts by (id,part) and reorder on resume.
hiro: Long-term: runtime/proxy should expose X-Chunk-Seq + part headers and ensure buffered queue drains before resume. Filing PROXY-891.
eng-bot: ticket PROXY-891 created by hiro at 2026-03-23T12:05:00Z
max: I'll open a tiny SDK PR with buffering + flaky test harness.
polly: Thanks, will validate canary once PR lands.
